question: In the adventure 'A Dungeon and a Dragon', what is the name and type of the main dragon antagonist, and how has it been monitoring the adventurers throughout the dungeon?
expected_answer: Valturnax, an adult green dragon. He has been spying on the party's progress through the dungeon via the eyes of rodents and birds throughout the complex. When the party reaches his lair, he has pre-cast Mislead and sits invisibly on the walkways. He announces himself and monologues before initiating combat, so no creature is surprised.
